case: DomainEvent's exclusive factory repointed to a command-shaped name that command-registry.json does not carry.
why: Before this repair `exclusive_factory` was read ZERO times by validate_contracts.py. Nine records declare one and not one of the nine strings was ever resolved against anything, so the sentence `only this path may create this record` was a comment that reads like a rule. This fixture is the shape that hole admits: a plausible command name, in the house style, naming nothing. It must be refused for the resolution check and not for a spelling rule, which is why the name is well-formed.
expect_failure_contains: AN EXCLUSIVE FACTORY RESOLVES TO NOTHING
